description: How much equity will NVIDIA hold in Intel, and at what total committed amount, at NVIDIA's next annual report, following its $5 billion equity investment in Intel?
outcome: The size and carrying amount of NVIDIA's equity stake in Intel, and any additional commitment, disclosed at NVIDIA's next annual report.

description: Will custom ASIC AI accelerators designed by Broadcom and Marvell take a growing share of the big four hyperscalers' AI accelerator spending in calendar 2027, at Nvidia's expense, given their lower cost per gigawatt?
outcome: The split of big-four hyperscaler 2027 AI accelerator spending (and of the 19.5 GW of incremental compute capacity projected for 2027) between custom ASIC racks and Nvidia GPU racks, measured against the item's cost-per-gigawatt estimates of $6–11 billion for Broadcom/Marvell ASIC racks versus roughly $19 billion for Nvidia GB300-based racks and $25 billion under Vera Rubin.

description: How much will NVIDIA have invested in Firmus Technologies, and what equity stake will it hold, following its reported ~$500 million ($721 million) subscription to Firmus' $2.9 billion equity raising, once Firmus lists on the ASX?
outcome: The amount NVIDIA invests and the equity stake it holds in Firmus Technologies after its preference shares convert to ordinary equity at Firmus' ASX IPO.

description: How much will U.S. federal agencies obligate in AI-related spending in calendar/fiscal 2026, and how much in new AI-related contract awards will be recorded?
outcome: The total AI-related spending obligated by U.S. federal agencies in 2026 (reported at $7.2 billion so far, versus $675 million in 2024) and the value of potential AI contract awards (reported at $91.8 billion, versus $4.6 billion in 2024).

description: How much new high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity will the three main producers (SK Hynix, Micron, Samsung) bring online, and will the HBM shortage keep memory prices at record highs through late 2027 — a supply and input-cost constraint on NVIDIA's GPU shipments?
outcome: The state of HBM supply and pricing through late 2027: whether any meaningful new HBM capacity comes online before then, and whether record-high HBM/memory prices persist.

description: How much will DRAM, NAND and high-bandwidth memory contract prices rise in calendar 2026, and what will the memory content of NVIDIA's Vera Rubin VR200 rack cost, now that memory is reported to be 25-30% of the rack bill of materials?
outcome: The direction and size of 2026 memory contract price increases and the memory cost per NVIDIA Vera Rubin rack (Morgan Stanley currently puts memory content at about $2 million per rack, up 435%), which bears on NVIDIA's per-rack cost/ASP economics and on hyperscaler AI-infrastructure spending.

description: Will global semiconductor revenue reach roughly $975 billion in calendar 2026, including about $500 billion from AI chip sales, as Deloitte estimates?
outcome: Calendar 2026 global semiconductor industry revenue and the AI-chip portion of it, the aggregate that underpins demand for Nvidia's data center products.

description: How much will the top U.S. hyperscalers spend on custom AI accelerators (ASIC/XPU chips such as those Marvell designs for Amazon and Microsoft) in calendar 2026, and how much AI-accelerator demand is bypassing NVIDIA GPUs?
outcome: The dollar volume of hyperscaler custom-ASIC purchases in calendar 2026 (as reflected in the ASIC vendors' custom AI silicon revenue) versus those hyperscalers' NVIDIA GPU purchases — a measure of how far AI compute is shifting from NVIDIA GPUs to custom silicon for inference.

description: How much new high-bandwidth memory (HBM) production capacity will SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung bring online in calendar 2027, and will it arrive early enough to ease the current HBM shortage and record prices that gate NVIDIA's GPU output?
outcome: The combined new HBM capacity the three producers add in 2027 and whether any of it arrives before late 2027, easing the shortage; measured against the item's forecast that no new HBM supply arrives before late 2027.

description: Will global high-bandwidth memory (HBM) shipments grow by approximately 50%-60% in calendar 2027, still falling short of demand, as the item projects?
outcome: Global HBM shipment growth and whether HBM supply remains short of demand in calendar 2027.

description: Will the US government keep in force, broaden, or tighten its approval allowing Nvidia to sell some of its semiconductors to China under specified conditions, and at what scale will those permitted China sales occur?
outcome: Whether US export-control approval for Nvidia semiconductor sales to China remains in force, is expanded, or is restricted, and the resulting scale of Nvidia's permitted China sales.

description: What will contract prices for AI memory (LPDDR5X, HBM, 3D NAND/DRAM) be through calendar 2026-2027 — the input that now makes up roughly 25-30% of Nvidia's Vera Rubin rack cost?
outcome: The level and direction of contract memory (DRAM, NAND, HBM) prices in 2026-2027 and the resulting per-rack memory content cost (about $2 million on the VR200).
